architecture_review.integration_policy: Retain all existing packages, tasks, requirements and dependencies. Findings describe the reviewed baseline, not a fresh audit. Review P1/P2 severity is distinct from backlog P0/P1/P2 scheduling. Open findings close only on their linked acceptance evidence.
preserve: Shared parser and useful semantic code

findings.title: Committed state, gesture previews and saved state
findings.evidence_kind: Reproduced correctness defect; separate intermittent test failure
findings.evidence: Drag X=100 to 150, save, then Escape: saved X=150, live X=100, document clean. The first 454-test suite also had one dirty-state failure.
findings.limitations: The autosave schedule was not separately exercised. An immediate focused rerun, ten isolated reruns and a second full suite passed; this does not close the intermittent finding.
findings.response: Separate previews from committed state; decide Save during gestures; acknowledge exact snapshots and preserve undo-to-saved behavior.
findings.closure_criteria: Drag/save/cancel and save/undo/redo agree on live, saved and dirty state; overlapping saves and newer edits pass; intermittent failures have a documented disposition.

findings.title: Incremental calculation and reusable evaluation
findings.evidence: One insertion spent 222.7–1,312.2 ms in ShapeSheet and 68.5–73.6 ms in text fields. Control dragging recalculates both baseline and moved documents.
findings.limitations: Insertion timings are individual observations. No large-document control-drag timing was measured.
findings.response: Track affected closures, dynamic references, volatility and local cycles; retain compiled expressions/contexts; audit text measurement and reject stale workers.
findings.closure_criteria: Incremental/full evaluation and diagnostics agree; small edits skip unrelated work; pre-gesture issues are reused and stale results cannot overwrite edits.

findings.title: Retained rendering and dirty-region rejection
findings.evidence: On 3,909 shapes, a 16×16 draw took 92.4 ms versus 99.3 ms for the viewport; painting can also enter background-field recalculation.
findings.limitations: Draw timings are five-run medians after one warmup; they do not establish p95 or event-loop frame pacing.
findings.response: Prepare immutable evaluated scenes; retain paths/text/order/bounds; cull before preparation; use lightweight interaction overlays.
findings.closure_criteria: Painting never calculates or mutates; small dirty regions visit only conservative candidates; caches remain bounded and source/render fixtures pass.

findings.title: Indexed hierarchy, selection, hit testing and routing
findings.evidence_kind: Measured and source-confirmed; routing scaling risk
findings.evidence: Select-all reached 300.0 ms and a miss hit-test 18.4 ms on 3,909 shapes; hierarchy and route preparation repeatedly rebuild maps/scans.
findings.limitations: All routes together cost under 1 ms on each measured page. Routing was not the dominant bottleneck in this fixture.
findings.response: Maintain ID/hierarchy/draw-order/adjacency/spatial indexes; use nearby snap candidates and route caches with conservative obstacle invalidation.
findings.closure_criteria: Indexed hit/marquee queries match full scans and effective draw order; small changes update bounded indexes/routes; nested and uncached-connector fixtures pass.

findings.title: Selective UI updates and persistent controls
findings.evidence: Single selection cost 8.1–8.8 ms before drawing; editor refresh cost 9.3–10.4 ms. Inspector/page/stencil refresh reconstructs controls or lists.
findings.limitations: Large-stencil allocation/layout scaling was not quantified.
findings.response: Publish typed changes; keep inspector and page controls alive; reuse library rows/thumbnails and compute availability once per selection revision.
findings.closure_criteria: Selection and page switching avoid unrelated reconstruction, retain per-page view state and active edits, and show mixed values and units.

findings.title: Shared screen/output semantics and visible diagnostics
findings.evidence: Foreground canvas bypasses layer overrides used by exports. The measured run produced 31 calculation issues, while editor notes expose import warnings only.
findings.limitations: SVG/public-layer tests do not qualify foreground canvas correctness.
findings.response: Share evaluated scenes and explicit visibility/printability policy; expose structured page/shape/cell issues with cache state and safe actions.
findings.closure_criteria: Layer/color/output fixtures agree across screen/export; material calculation/import issues remain navigable to the affected object/cell.

findings.title: Bounded I/O, resource ownership and save rebasing
findings.evidence_kind: Source-confirmed; measured load cost; unmeasured memory risk
findings.evidence: Legacy/template/stencil opens and exports remain synchronous. Native metadata decoding took 2.38 of 2.90 seconds; saves retain the original patch baseline.
findings.limitations: No leak, out-of-memory result or rebasing data-loss defect was measured. Snapshot undo uses copy-on-write, not an eager copy of every byte.
findings.response: Use bounded cancellable owned jobs, revision-safe rebasing and immutable resources; measure and cap decoded-image/cache/undo costs.
findings.closure_criteria: Every long workflow preserves UI heartbeat; stale/cancel/failure keeps valid state; repeated saves and twenty lifecycle cycles satisfy declared memory budgets.

findings.title: Independent compatibility and first-class domain identities
findings.evidence: The recorded Windows guest lacks registered Visio; real Visio open/edit/save/reopen acceptance is absent. Masters, connector sheets and relationship kinds need explicit domains.
findings.limitations: Parsing, cached display and preserved opaque content do not prove editing, behavior or interoperability. Reference status must be reinspected.
findings.response: Freeze the exact reference and inventory; track preservation/rendering/editing/behavior/interchange separately; qualify public-content vertical workflows.
findings.closure_criteria: Exact-build reference round trips pass; all five evidence dimensions and inventory entries remain traceable; no private-metadata or native-equivalence substitution closes compatibility.

findings.title: Product-quality tests and trusted stable releases
findings.evidence: The first 454-test suite had one dirty-state failure; later reruns passed. CI lacks controlled performance/accessibility/update-install gates and permits an ad hoc stable publication path.
findings.limitations: The review did not establish that the locally inspected bundle was unsigned. Sparkle artifact signing and Developer ID/notarization are separate controls.
findings.response: Require stable manifests, intended signing/notarization and platform evidence; exercise installed updates, recovery, controlled performance and real event routing.
findings.closure_criteria: The exact installed candidate passes platform, update/recovery, security, performance and compatibility gates; undiagnosed release-blocking intermittency prevents acceptance.

findings.title: Enforced boundaries, shared semantics and readable state paths
findings.evidence: One executable target contains app, format and profiling code; 624 source lines exceed 200 characters. Evaluation dispatch and numeric coordinate spaces span multiple contexts.
findings.limitations: Feature-led development is an interpretation of history plus the call graph; commit cadence does not establish review quality or authorship.
findings.response: Stabilize logical contracts, then extract a few targets; separate tooling, adopt a formatter/typed states/invariants and useful unit-aware coordinates; share function definitions.
findings.closure_criteria: Pure model/calculation boundaries exclude UI; tools leave production entry points; critical code is formatted and shared semantic/coordinate contracts have meaningful fixtures.

findings.title: Native accessibility and whole-workflow usability
findings.evidence: Canvas lacks semantic shape/connector accessibility elements; editor panes and page/selection workflows need keyboard, mixed-value and state-retention policies.
findings.limitations: No complete VoiceOver/usability study or supported-platform matrix was qualified; source deployment target alone does not prove bundled dependency support.
findings.response: Back accessible scene elements with stable IDs; implement focus/connection journeys, adaptive panes, international text and bundle-derived platform evidence.
findings.closure_criteria: Real keyboard/VoiceOver journeys create, connect, edit, inspect, save and export; representative window sizes, fonts and all advertised platforms have evidence.

contracts.contract: Painting and hit testing do not evaluate formulas, parse files or mutate the document.
Selection, zoom and gesture previews do not trigger semantic recalculation.
Every committed edit has an affected set, one undo contract, stable identities and an invalidation result.
Calculation, route and job results identify inputs and cannot overwrite newer incompatible state.
Saves acknowledge exactly their committed snapshot; failure preserves the last valid destination and unsaved state.
Paths, text, styles, routes and diagnostics have explicit dependency keys and budgets.
Screen and export share semantics; editing decorations and output policies remain explicit.
Unsupported content has a preservation/editing policy and object-level diagnostics.
